description: Review and improve a Masheev AI agent from an AI assistant connected to the Masheev MCP server. Use when asked why the AI agent gave a wrong answer, to "improve my bot", tighten its instructions, add knowledge it is missing, pause or resume it, or check whether its channels are set up. Reads recent conversations and escalations as evidence, proposes concrete instruction or knowledge changes, and applies them only after the owner approves.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
